routedDefects.rule: a send log must have at least 10 calls
routedDefects.reason: redundant: plan-calls refuses any send log short enough to trip the length rule (the intercept/mouse/trigger sequence cannot fit in <10 calls), so no receipt escapes on length alone

routedDefects.rule: the answer must name exactly the planned file
routedDefects.reason: redundant: accept-answer-law / webkitdirectory-answer-law pin answer.setParams.files[0] to the planned basename, so plan-calls answer-files cannot be the only detector

routedDefects.rule: chooser mode must be selectSingle or selectMultiple
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape compares `opened` (the mode array) and mode-law compares the same value, so any mode change fires leg-<name> first

routedDefects.rule: a cross-origin chooser must follow the prior click within 3 sends
routedDefects.from: if (!(Number.isInteger(leg.priorReleaseId) && o.afterSendId >= leg.priorReleaseId && o.afterSendId <= leg.priorReleaseId + 3)) evBad.push(leg.name + ':open-binding');
routedDefects.reason: vacuous: no honest cross-origin leg opens a chooser (both throw SecurityError), and any added open is refused by intercept-law and the per-leg shape before the afterSendId window matters

routedDefects.rule: at most two chooser opens per leg
routedDefects.reason: redundant: a third chooser open changes the per-leg `opened` array (leg-<name>) and click-while-open-law, both of which fire

routedDefects.rule: event.target must be null or a string
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape seq is type@target, so any target change fires leg-<name>

routedDefects.rule: event.files must be null or an array
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape `files` column lists every event whose files is non-null, so any files change fires leg-<name>

routedDefects.rule: event.seq must be an integer
routedDefects.reason: redundant: seq-monotonic requires seq === i+1 exactly, so a non-integer seq fires seq-monotonic

routedDefects.rule: a throwing showPicker must carry the frozen message
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the only throwing parent showPicker law is sp81-same-origin-nonfile-disabled, whose message order-law pins separately

routedDefects.rule: a leg without a frozen showPicker law is refused
routedDefects.reason: vacuous: all six planned legs have a frozen SP_LAW entry; a leg without one cannot pass plan-frozen/leg-order/leg-records

routedDefects.rule: a multiple input must open selectMultiple
routedDefects.reason: redundant: fixture-descriptors pins fixtureInputs to FIXTURE_INPUTS, so the multiple flag cannot be flipped to create a selectMultiple witness

routedDefects.rule: a chooser whose input descriptor is missing is refused
routedDefects.reason: redundant: fixture-descriptors refuses any fixtureInputs array that loses a descriptor

routedDefects.rule: the child click must fire exactly five events
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the child event shape check compares the full type@target sequence, so a 5->4 or 5->6 change fires the same cross-origin-nonfile-law id

routedDefects.rule: the cross-origin disabled call must open nothing
routedDefects.reason: redundant: an added chooser on the cross-origin disabled leg fires intercept-law and the per-leg `opened` shape as well

routedDefects.rule: the same-origin disabled call must open nothing
routedDefects.reason: redundant: an added chooser on the same-origin disabled leg fires intercept-law and the per-leg `opened` shape as well

routedDefects.rule: the same-origin disabled call must fail (ok === false)
routedDefects.reason: redundant: flipping sod.showPicker.ok to true also fires gesture-law and intercept-law

routedDefects.rule: setParams.files must be exactly the directory basename
routedDefects.reason: redundant: changing answer.setParams.files makes plan-calls want differ from the send log, so plan-calls fires

routedDefects.rule: the directory answer must populate the input with webkitRelativePath
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape state column compares stateAfter.d, so any change fires leg-sp81-webkitdirectory-answer

routedDefects.rule: both directory files must be read
routedDefects.reason: redundant: removing a read event changes the per-leg seq, so leg-sp81-webkitdirectory-answer fires

routedDefects.rule: the accept answer must populate the input with the .txt
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape state column compares stateAfter.k

routedDefects.rule: the accepted file must be read exactly once
routedDefects.reason: redundant: removing the read event changes the per-leg seq

routedDefects.rule: exactly one trusted click on s
routedDefects.reason: redundant: a second click@s changes the per-leg seq, so leg-sp81-click-while-open fires

routedDefects.rule: the click on s must be trusted and active
routedDefects.from: arr(cw.pageEvents).filter((e) => e.type === 'click' && e.target === 's').every((e) => e.isTrusted === true && e.act === true)
routedDefects.reason: redundant: trust-law requires every page event to be trusted, so an untrusted click fires trust-law

routedDefects.rule: no non-cancel event may carry files outside the answer legs
routedDefects.reason: redundant: adding an input/change event changes the per-leg seq; setting files on an existing event changes the per-leg files column

routedDefects.rule: the state object must have exactly the seven frozen keys
routedDefects.reason: redundant: the per-leg frozen shape state column compares the whole state object, so an extra or missing key fires leg-<name>

routedDefects.rule: a leg that opens fewer choosers than its trigger implies is refused
routedDefects.reason: redundant: a missing chooser open changes the per-leg `opened` array, so leg-<name> fires

routedDefects.rule: a cross leg opens a chooser only when the child call succeeded
routedDefects.from: CROSS.has(leg.name) ? isObj(leg.childResult) && leg.childResult.ok === true : isObj(leg.showPicker) && leg.showPicker.ok === true
routedDefects.to: CROSS.has(leg.name) ? isObj(leg.childResult) && leg.childResult.ok !== false : isObj(leg.showPicker) && leg.showPicker.ok === true
routedDefects.reason: redundant: cross-origin-nonfile-law / order-law pin childResult exactly, so a childResult without ok fires there

routedDefects.rule: a post-hoc cancel must not fire a page cancel
routedDefects.reason: redundant: cancel-law refuses any page cancel event in this generation

routedDefects.rule: startedAt/finishedAt must parse
routedDefects.reason: redundant: an unparseable startedAt/finishedAt yields NaN, which fails both t1 - t0 >= 12000 and t1 - t0 < 600000

routedDefects.rule: a pair match is within 0.05 ms
routedDefects.reason: vacuous: every page-event ts/at is on the 0.1 ms grid (event-time-quantum), so a pair either matches exactly or differs by >= 0.1 ms > TOL; any TOL in (1e-4, 0.05] is behaviourally identical and no receipt can distinguish it

routedDefects.rule: the per-leg trusted column is compared
routedDefects.reason: redundant: trust-law requires every page event to be trusted, so dropping the per-leg trusted column cannot be the only detector

killed.rule: every leg must carry a fresh main frame tree (parent null)
the click must leave exactly two choosers open
no page cancel event may fire in this generation
a post-hoc cancel must be accepted with {}
the devtools port must be the argv CDP port
the unparsable scan keys on the r81 schema string
the per-leg xy/buttons column is compared
the per-leg files column is compared
